rules.content:
title: CMLN Wallet Cluster Velocity
status: experimental
description: Detect cryptocurrency wallet clusters exhibiting CMLN operational characteristics: high transaction velocity (average processing time under 2 minutes), incoming transfers from multiple unrelated sourc
logsource:
    product: crypto
    category: blockchain_analytics
    service: chain_monitoring
detection:
    selection:
        wallet_cluster: true
        avg_processing_time|lt: 120
        inbound_source_count|gt: 10
        outbound_to_exchange_ratio|gt: 0.7
    condition: selection
level: high
rules.title: DL-0113: CMLN Wallet Cluster Velocity (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: No-KYC Exchange Off-Ramp Pattern
status: experimental
description: Detect cryptocurrency flows matching the DPRK 45-day laundering cycle pattern: initial rapid distancing through DeFi protocols (days 1-5), integration through no-KYC exchanges (days 5-14), and off-ram
logsource:
    product: crypto
    category: blockchain_analytics
    service: chain_monitoring
detection:
    selection:
        defi_hop_count|gte: 3
        defi_hop_timeframe|lte: "5d"
        no_kyc_exchange_deposit_timeframe|lte: "14d"
        otc_broker_withdrawal_timeframe|lte: "45d"
    condition: selection and temporal_sequence
level: high
rules.title: DL-0114: No-KYC Exchange Off-Ramp Pattern (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Crypto Rug Pull On-Chain Indicators")`
index=blockchain sourcetype=defi:events
| eval risk_score = case(
    liquidity_removal_pct > 80, 10,
    top5_holder_pct > 0.60, 7,
    has_hidden_mint = "true", 8,
    has_hidden_pause = "true", 6,
    liquidity_unlocked = "true", 5,
    1=1, 0
  )
| where risk_score >= 7
| table _time, token_address, token_name, risk_score,
        liquidity_removal_pct, top5_holder_pct,
        has_hidden_mint, has_hidden_pause, liquidity_unlocked
rules.title: DL-0142: Crypto Token Rug Pull Early Warning — On-Chain and OSINT Indicators (SPLUNK)
